newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai T-bill repo rates end down, spots up.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai T-bill repo rates end down, spots up.

text.p: Contracts on the treasury bill repurchase market in Shanghai closed mostly down on Wednesday mainly because demand for funds from the domestic A share market declined, traders said.
The annual rate for the most active seven-day contract ended lower at 9.98 percent from 14.90 percent on Tuesday.
Turnover fell to 6.17 million lots from 6.48 million. One lot is 1,000 yuan face value of treasury bills.
"Some institutions borrowed a lot of money on the repo market in the past few days," one trader said. "This made their demand decline today despite two new A share listings."
